items.sentence: Every citizen has a legal duty to follow established traffic safety rules.
Responsible drivers obey traffic signals to protect pedestrians crossing streets safely.
Police officers arrest the criminal suspect based on solid forensic evidence.
Journalists report factual news events accurately in the evening newspaper article.
The jury found the innocent defendant not guilty of the crime.
Pedestrians should exercise caution when crossing icy roads in winter mornings.
Electric vehicle owners charge their car battery at local charging stations.
Drivers who violate speed limits receive a monetary fine from police.
Democratic society relies on the fair rule of constitutional public law.
Eating raw meat can cause severe food poisoning from harmful bacteria.
